hfpclawer-academic-integrity 0.19.0

- Added ability to extract citations from paper drafts (text, URL, or PDF) and verify each against local, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex sources.
- Detects fabricated references, misattributed authors, and incorrect publication years, generating a detailed integrity report.
- Supports multiple input formats and verification levels, with clear status definitions (VERIFIED, SUSPECTED, NOT_FOUND, FABRICATED, ERROR).
- Includes configuration and environment variable guidance for optimal setup and performance.
- Targeted at researchers, reviewers, and literature survey authors for automated citation integrity auditing.
